_comment: Table Health Advisor settings. orphan_min_age_minutes is test scale (3, the hot window); production should be days (Iceberg's remove_orphan_files default is 3 days = 4320) so in-flight writes are never counted. orphan_scan_every_hours / retained_bytes_every_hours: 0 = whenever the table changed (test); production ~24. advisor_mode: auto | approve-only | off, the default; a table's own advisor.mode property wins. 'defaults' apply to every table; 'tables' overrides per table ('thresholds' merges key by key). Test scale: target file size is 8 MB (64x below Iceberg's 512 MB default) so small test tables show real symptoms. Thresholds were calibrated on the first gl-metrics run of S0-S6 (2026-10-02); production values are noted in the README.

rewrite._comment: Options plan.py puts on the CALLs. min_input_files null = min_excess_files + 1, so every flagged partition is one the rewrite will change.

incremental._comment: GL2.5m incremental scan. Per family: off | shadow (full path decides, both compared in glue.ops.incremental_check) | on (ledger decides; spot_check_share of tables and any table not compared for reconcile_every_days are still compared). Family 1 (snapshot_ledger) passed shadow 2026-10-03 and is on; family 2 (partition_activity) reports and compares only (shadow); family 3 (learned_windows: hot window = 2 x p95 commit gap between hot_partition_minutes and hot_cap_minutes, settle window = p99 lateness up to settle_cap_hours, the hot window needs min_gaps commit gaps after leaving out idle gaps longer than idle_gap_factor x the median gap, the settle window and LATE_ARRIVALS' lateness trigger need min_batches batches) shows what would change (shadow) or decides (on). Family 4 comes later. Lookback: histogram_days, extended whole days at a time (adaptive_lookback) up to lookback_max_days until a table has min_batches / min_gaps samples. Until a table has min_batches batches, a large append later than cold_start_backfill_hours is labelled possible_backfill.
